name: Fractal Spectral Density Regime Switching
concept: Uses fractal dimension and spectral density to identify regime switching in US100 5-minute candles, with dynamic parameter optimization.
instructions: Calculate the fractal dimension of the price series using the Higuchi algorithm. Compute the spectral density using the Lomb-Scargle periodogram. Identify regime switches when the fractal dimension crosses a threshold of 1.2. Optimize parameters dynamically based on the current regime.

name: State-Space Volatility Modeling
concept: Uses state-space models to identify volatility regimes in US100 5-minute candles, with dynamic parameter optimization.
instructions: Fit a state-space model to the price series using the Kalman filter. Identify volatility regimes based on the state estimates. Optimize parameters dynamically based on the current volatility regime.
